about: A simulated week of the daily loop, 11 to 17 November 2026: stories are added to the backlog on the day they surfaced, the list is ranked each morning, five are published under the mix rules (including the floor of 12 for a new story to take a slot from the bank), and published stories are marked in data/backlog.json. Stories were found by one-off fetches, a model triage of headlines and agent source checks, not by the live pull.
